name: Smith.ai

integrations: Clio, MyCase, Lawmatics, CallRail, Salesforce, Calendly, Zapier; ServiceTitan/Jobber native on live tier

name: Goodcall
starting_price: Starter $79/mo for 100 unique customers, then 79¢ each; Growth $129/mo; Scale $299/mo

human_handoff: FAQ: configure an escalation contact so the agent can transfer the caller to a person
hipaa_baa: Signs a BAA on the Scale plan ($299/mo) and Enterprise, before calls that involve patient information
integrations: Zapier, calendars
notes: Own healthcare page names primary care, specialty practices, dental, mental health, and urgent care. No native dental PMS write-back was restated on that page.

name: Dialzara
human_handoff: Blind transfer on entry plan; warm transfer on Pro

name: Ruby

integrations: Clio, Rocket Matter
notes: Human receptionists with optional AI front end.

name: JustCall

hipaa_baa: Healthcare page says HIPAA-compliant and signed BAAs for eligible healthcare teams
integrations: CRM logging; PMS via custom API
notes: Healthcare page describes AI Voice Agent for patient calls, bookings, and transfers. A standalone monthly price for the agent alone is not published on the pricing page.

name: Arini

notes: Plans page still labels AI Receptionist as early access. Questions page says Weave is built for dental, medical, veterinary, optical, and specialty healthcare.

name: OnCrew
starting_price: Starter $49/mo with 150 minutes of answered calls, then $0.49/min; Pro $149/mo with 200 minutes, then $0.99/min; Multi-Truck $349/mo with 500 minutes, then $0.99/min
billing_model: Per answered minute, after a monthly included allowance
human_handoff: Pricing page lists live transfers that announce the caller before connecting (Starter includes 4 destinations). On Nov 9, 2026, OnCrew told us live transfer is not turned on for new accounts yet; on-call rotation is live (urgent calls text the person on call, and every call emails the owner the recording and summary).

notes: No setup fee. Annual billing is available on request and takes two months off any plan. The pricing page says answered calls averaged about 1.2 minutes.
